elements.element: TrueLink shall maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no commercial general liability insurance requirement.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance shall have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability per-occurrence limit is included.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance shall have an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability aggregate limit is included.

elements.element: TrueLink shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires professional liability insurance of only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If TrueLink processes Customer Data, TrueLink shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance, but only at USD 2,000,000 rather than USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: TrueLink shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no workers' compensation insurance requirement.

elements.element: TrueLink shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no obligation to provide certificates of insurance upon request.

elements.element: TrueLink shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: TrueLink shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause requires cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The operative addition exactly supplies both stated fallback coverages and limits, without changing the force majeure provision or adding unrelated obligations. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it omits commercial general liability, workers' compensation, and certificates on request, and provides lower E&O and cyber/privacy limits. Drafting quality is adequate, though it does not specify whether the E&O and cyber limits apply per claim, per occurrence, or in the aggregate.
